column3: Austin has lead several projects here at the Denison plant that resulted in reduced downtime and maintenance spend. Onsite or offsite Austin always checks in with the team to ensure that everything is going smoothly and wants to know about any issues he could potentially correct. Austin always has a positive attitude and willing to assist anyone however he can. Thank you for your continued support of keeping the business running.

This past week the Denison Maintenance Department has had several automation issues. Rick saw we were struggling and without asking assisted with working with OEMs on a solution. One of these events was Rick working late into the night (11pm) . Thank you for your continuous support of keeping the business running.
